owner.line: - 2026-09-06 · owner · M2-RULE — the owner's disposition of the M2 audit, given on rebuild/m2/OWNER-RULING-PACK-M2.md v3 (5,579 bytes, sha256 2568a221bfd50138b4ab4d5bd13efbbf46f66a3ad789bb4127255ba10a2269a9, committed at 4e561e5): owner, exact words received in the Codex coordinator task 01a06e0c-39ea-7591-9666-eead44de251c — a user-role annotation selecting "Approve Batch A and all seven recommended choices", then user-role "Continue" — relayed verbatim by Astra with that provenance on 2026-09-06 14:40 UTC; cowork independently verified the pack correspondence (pack bytes/sha and the register's 38 FIX + 7 OWNER RULING split match the relay) and did NOT directly observe the Codex UI; the Message-35 route governs transport only and did not originate this ruling; recorded as the owner's ruling in his own words, not a recommendation and not an inference from the integration Go — the owner may correct it at any time by an appended line. BATCH A APPROVED as one batch — every FIX recommendation of rebuild/m2/AUDIT-REGISTER.md becomes an approved repair direction: D1 APPROVED-FIX · D2 APPROVED-FIX · D3 APPROVED-FIX · D4 APPROVED-FIX · D5 APPROVED-FIX · D6 APPROVED-FIX · D7 APPROVED-FIX · D9 APPROVED-FIX · D11 APPROVED-FIX · D12 APPROVED-FIX · D13 APPROVED-FIX · D14 APPROVED-FIX · D15 APPROVED-FIX · D17 APPROVED-FIX · D18 APPROVED-FIX · D19 APPROVED-FIX · D20 APPROVED-FIX · D21 APPROVED-FIX · D22 APPROVED-FIX · D23 APPROVED-FIX · D24 APPROVED-FIX · D26 APPROVED-FIX · D27 APPROVED-FIX · D28 APPROVED-FIX · D29 APPROVED-FIX · D30 APPROVED-FIX · D31 APPROVED-FIX · D33 APPROVED-FIX · D34 APPROVED-FIX · D35 APPROVED-FIX · D36 APPROVED-FIX · D38 APPROVED-FIX · D39 APPROVED-FIX · D41 APPROVED-FIX · D42 APPROVED-FIX · D43 APPROVED-FIX · D44 APPROVED-FIX · D45 APPROVED-FIX (38). BATCH B — all seven RECOMMENDED answers chosen, each now an approved repair direction with its exact rule: D8 APPROVED-FIX — when last night's sleep is missing, recovery is UNKNOWN and no sleep restriction is applied today; every other recovery check still applies (not carry-forward of the last logged night). D10 APPROVED-FIX — date-only week counts mean 7 CALENDAR days, not 168 elapsed hours. D16 APPROVED-FIX — a 7-day forecast hit requires an eligible weigh-in on the due day or, failing that, the next day (one grace date); with no such reading the forecast is UNGRADED, not a miss; the day arithmetic follows D10. D25 APPROVED-FIX — "protein: good" requires at least one successful day within the current seven-logged-days window before the one-miss allowance applies; a first missed day cannot read "good". D32 APPROVED-FIX — "benefit replicated" counts only sessions from the CURRENT technique; all other replication thresholds stay as they are. D37 APPROVED-FIX — a merged earned receipt keeps the assessment as of the day it was earned, accepting that this can change whether a single-sighting increase counts as earned and the numbers printed on past earned receipts. D40 APPROVED-FIX — when two phones disagree on a day's calories with equal detail, ONE deterministic shared winner is chosen with the conflict kept visible and BOTH original entries retained; the exact tie-break rule and how the conflict is shown are NOT decided here and must be specified in the reviewed fix brief before anything is built. Totals: 45/45 dispositions recorded, 45 APPROVED-FIX, 0 KEEP, 0 DEFER, 0 UNRULED. What this does NOT do: it approves directions, not code — each theme still needs its accepted behaviour/delta brief, its red-first laws turning GREEN on the candidate and RED on the frozen engine, the post-fix gate's PACKAGE run and cowork's execution acceptance; the frozen app and its goldens stay untouched; no private release, spending, phone gate, remote gate or M2 closure is waived; no owner-specific interval or value is set. Transport: the route ruling at line 42 applies; no additional Go was requested or given · rebuild/m2/OWNER-RULING-PACK-M2.md · M2-RULE DONE; M2-FIX unblocked for briefs (D33–D35 first, per the accepted PR #34 contract)

notes: B-NTC is the package DECISIONS:103 (1) ruled FIRST in the B chain: it turns the accepted open boundary PERFORMED_NATIVE_TREND_CONTEXT_REQUIRED into a qualified provider. The implementation is speculative and lives on rebuild/lane-b-ntc @ 68fbca4; this spec is the tooling side of it and is authored here so the runner admits the id — STATUS 2026-09-11 05:50 ET recorded "--package B-NTC REFUSED (closed id list) -> tooling fixer widens it".

dIds and laws are EMPTY on purpose and the runner allows it only because B-NTC is named in the runner’s own NO_REGISTER_IDS set: DECISIONS:93 rules that feature work under the ratified slice plan takes no register D-ID. A repair package can never empty its own inventory — the exemption is fixed in b-package.cjs, not here.

PRODUCT ROLES. "carried" = the 20 files the parent artifact pins in its PRODUCT map, byte-identical (pre === post). "new" = a file this package brings into the inventory that the parent pins nowhere — the four here: native-trend-context.cjs and its test cell are not authored on this branch at all, so their pre-image is the sha256 of the empty byte string; workout-host.mjs and host/test/journey.test.mjs exist and carry their real bytes at sourceBase as the pre-image (neither is a parent pin — checked against acceptance-native-carriers.json's product map and its 31 executionPins). "superseded-by-child" (TOOLING-REVIEW-r4 Y1) = a file the parent pins in EXECUTIONPINS and this package supersedes inside its own seal: .github/workflows/rebuild.yml, whose pre-image is the parent's own execution pin f57ced40… and is asserted equal to it by product(). DECISIONS:109 rules that supersession ("a child package supersedes its parent's execution pins exactly as NATIVE-CARRIERS superseded LOAD-WRITES") and puts the rebuild.yml enumeration and the retirement of the `# pass 19` child inside THIS seal; before r4 the only role that admitted such a file was "new", which is false of a file the parent pins, and it carried no pre-image equality at all. Any further parent execution pin this package re-pins (DECISIONS:109 names engine-runtime.cjs and the EXPOSED set) is declared with the same role at seal time — the runner refuses "new" for a parent-pinned file. EVERY post is null on this branch, which is what makes PRODUCT read NOT-IMPLEMENTED — the post-images are re-taken when the B-NTC carrier lands on the accepted head, and until then this spec claims nothing about them.

The authored bytes on rebuild/lane-b-ntc @ 68fbca4, recorded here for the re-take and asserted by NOTHING in this spec: native-trend-context.cjs cf8b50955ad0dca5ff91e528ae0abc48611cebeadc586e2759ec0ec587c22356 (12 375 B) · test/native-trend-context.test.cjs f0879ca2b6d2fd65cb125d2d013e64efd89f236a4893dcec7245bf460dc52559 (13 164 B) · workout-host.mjs 2d160c1c79fd7957febe964db523bc53dbb9a32fa571895f30e1a279a77fc480 · host/test/journey.test.mjs d4c68645474eb8f6b4acbd252b35b9f0ca31225f6269fea53416a8c8a712af96.

children[] re-executes the five accepted NATIVE-CARRIERS successor children, each with its exact declared verdict; those executions are what cover the nine inherited originals. B-NTC declares no child of its OWN yet: its test cell rebuild/m4/workout/test/native-trend-context.test.cjs is not on this branch, and a child whose argv target does not exist refuses (CHILD-ARGV-TARGET). The remaining ten gates re-execute under --full. THIS IS THE Y1 OPEN OBLIGATION (TOOLING-REVIEW-r4 §5.1): because B-NTC registers no D-id, the 45-law accounting owes nothing on it and its "45/45 rows agree" line is the register baseline, not evidence about this package. The runner therefore requires at least MIN_OWN_CHILDREN declared child(ren) executing one of this package's own role:"new" product files — 0 of them stand today, the runner reports NO-REGISTER OBLIGATION 0 of 0 and carries it as an OPEN obligation, and the seal REFUSES (NO-REGISTER-PACKAGE-SEALED-WITHOUT-EXECUTING-ITS-OWN-PRODUCT) until the carrier lands and the cell is declared here.

The brief is not authored on this branch either, so brief.sha256 is pinned at the bytes committed on rebuild/lane-b-ntc @ 68fbca4 (0ba59cca…, 56 010 B) and the runner leaves "brief not authored" OPEN until the file is here to hash. theme stays null until the PM accepts BRIEF-B-NTC with a rebuild/DECISIONS.md line; no PASS word is available while it is null (THEME-AUTHORIZATION-UNAVAILABLE).

PARENT RE-PINNED (TOOLING-REPORT §r3 C): parent.options NATIVE-CARRIERS now names the DECISIONS:104 CI re-seal e940359b… in place of the DECISIONS:96 seal 295762f0…, and sourceBase is re-taken at the chain tip e9c50e1. The parent product map did not change across the re-seal, so the pre-image sha256s below are unchanged and were re-verified against the NEW artifact and against the bytes at that sourceBase.

PRE-IMAGE RE-VERIFICATION IS THE LANE’S, NOT THE TOOLING FIXER’S: 21 of the 25 product pre-images in this spec are the parent’s own pins carried forward (20 from its product map, 1 from its executionPins — .github/workflows/rebuild.yml), and the other four are this package’s own new files, two of which are not on this branch and carry the empty-string sha256. This package’s lane re-verifies them, and re-takes them if the engine moves under it, at seal time — nothing here is an independent measurement of the lane’s work.

coverage.moves is {} and must stay {} (TOOLING-REVIEW-r3 X1): the runner refuses any non-empty moves while MOVES_RULING is absent, in spec() and again at the seal in envelope(). That is what closes r3’s R3-A — the move/needle composite reaches nothing at all when no move can be declared, rather than being narrowly bounded.

parent.options[].reviewSha256 pins the parent’s REVIEW file by bytes, and option() additionally requires the receipt base that review names to be an ancestor of refs/remotes/origin/rebuild/t2-client-core — resolved from Git refs, never from this spec (TOOLING-REVIEW-r3 X2, closing R3-B).

SINGLE PARENT, TWO WAYS (TOOLING-REVIEW-r4 Y2). This spec is the one that names a parent, so it is the one the rule bites on. parent() refuses if any sibling packages/*.json claims acceptance-native-carriers.json as its chosen parent — read BOTH from disk AND from Git at HEAD, so freeing a sibling’s `chosen` in an uncommitted edit no longer frees the parent (r4 G14) — and refuses again if any already-sealed rebuild/m4/spec/acceptance-*.json ON refs/remotes/origin/rebuild/t2-client-core names it. Today the chain carries two sealed artifacts (acceptance-load-writes.json, parent acceptance-step-efficacy.json; acceptance-native-carriers.json, parent acceptance-load-writes.json) and neither names this one, so B-NTC is the first child of NATIVE-CARRIERS.
